image_description: A close-up shot of a dessert featuring a cylindrical cake or mousse base heavily coated in thick, dark chocolate sauce. The sauce drips down the sides in viscous ribbons and pools on the white plate. The top is garnished with bright red cherries and green leaves. A piece of what appears to be ice cream or cake sits to the left.
